architecture.rollout: native recursive rollout; recorded future six-heater inputs; predicted first six temperatures feed the next history; no teacher forcing and no Tp feedback

coisc.checkpoint_rule: final step75 state; no early stopping or selection

data_protocol.population: All 23 sources verified available before numeric inference: 17 original frozen_external_test + 6 original frozen_final_test
data_protocol.normalization: locked development fit-field normalization; no refit

primary_endpoints.aggregation_clarification: Frozen primary aggregation is equal-source/source-balanced. Development used legacy pooled aggregation. Endpoint concepts, numeric gates, lag, lambda, epsilon and checkpoints are unchanged.

prediction_noninferiority.decision: PASS iff upper endpoint of the two-sided 95% percentile cluster-bootstrap CI <= +0.005 C

ple.definition: equal-source mean of per-source mean abs(S) over eligible pre-lag cells
ple.decision: PASS iff R0>0, point_COISC<=0.9*point_R0, and upper endpoint of the two-sided 95% percentile cluster-bootstrap CI of (PLE_COISC-0.9*PLE_R0)<=0

wsr.definition: equal-source mean of per-source wrong-sign fraction over eligible post-lag cells; S < -epsilon_sign
wsr.decision: PASS iff R0>0, point_COISC<=0.9*point_R0, and upper endpoint of the two-sided 95% percentile cluster-bootstrap CI of (WSR_COISC-0.9*WSR_R0)<=0

psm.definition: equal-source weighted empirical median of post-lag abs(S), with each source total weight equal and each post cell weight inversely proportional to that source's post-cell count
psm.decision: PASS iff point_COISC>=max(0.2*point_R0,0.0005), lower endpoint of the two-sided 95% percentile cluster-bootstrap CI of (PSM_COISC-0.2*PSM_R0)>=0, and lower endpoint of the two-sided 95% percentile cluster-bootstrap CI of (PSM_COISC-0.0005)>=0

primary_endpoints.overall: PASS only when all four gates pass for all three seeds and completeness/integrity pass; any seed FAIL gives overall FAIL; missing/nonfinite/paired mismatch gives NOT_EVALUABLE and overall false

bootstrap.cluster: whole source with all its windows, horizons, outputs and paired R0/COISC values retained together
bootstrap.stratified_resampling: Sample 17 available external source IDs with replacement and 6 available final source IDs with replacement; preserve duplicates and role counts. Each of the 23 source clusters has equal weight.
bootstrap.shared_draw_table: one deterministic source multiplicity table shared by R0, COISC, all endpoints and all three model seeds

required_metrics.prediction: 7 outputs x 5 horizons: source-balanced MAE, RMSE and bias; retain window-level raw results
required_metrics.audit: source x horizon x output paired absolute-error delta, improvement/degradation/tie counts and source-level distributions
required_metrics.sensitivity: PLE, WSR, weighted PSM by output, seed, source and cohort; retain sensitivity distributions
required_metrics.collateral: seven-output macro prediction deltas by output, horizon and source; worsening distribution and strata

statistics.diagnostics: Failure-source and regime analyses are descriptive only and cannot change inclusion, thresholds, model or decision.
